title: The Finger-Pulling Breakdown
description: Garrick has spent the morning reading his own rules for a way out. He has five. Hear them out. Then say no.

objectives.text: Hear his loopholes (him)

title: Don't Throw My Sash in the Trash
summary: Your wardrobe smells from the deck.
description: Do something about the sash in your wardrobe. Something drastic.

objectives.text: Get rid of the sash (your wardrobe, in your cabin)
See what's on (the Mark II, in the galley)

title: The Sleeping Quarters Are Alive
summary: It's the bedding. Not the boards.
description: Open up the condemned quarters and see what's left in there. Something in there growls. One pillow, in particular, roars (pathetically). Throw it into the storm.

objectives.text: Open up the old quarters (the boarded door, at the bottom of the galley)
Go in (the old quarters)
Take the pillow that roars (the cot by the starboard wall)
Throw it into the Great Sharkstorm (up the ladder, the port rail)
Pick it up and throw it AGAIN (the deck, then the rail)

title: Condemn the Bedding
summary: Judge it. Pile it. Lock it away.
description: Every sheet, blanket, pillow, pillowcase, mattress cover and scrap of hammock cloth in the old quarters has the release in it. Judge them, pile them, get rid of them; and when that doesn't work, lock them up.

objectives.text: Judge the bedding: sheets, blankets, pillows, pillowcases, mattress covers, hammock cloth (all over the quarters)
Get the pile up on deck and over the side (the pile)
Lock it in the linen locker (the north wall)
Nail it shut (the linen locker)

title: Grand Stenchmaster Bedding
summary: The only clean cloth on the ship is two hundred and ninety toy sashes.
description: Remake the old quarters' bedding out of Cheap-O-Rama toy sashes.

objectives.text: Make sash bedding: the hammocks, the cot pads, the pillows, the blankets, the corners (round the quarters)

title: The Fan Mega-Pack
summary: It's back. It's lowering something into the QUARTERS.
description: The Bling Bling King has sent the Grand Stenchmaster Fan Mega-Pack. Open it. Put the cardboard Ancient Stenchmasters up wherever you like.

objectives.text: Open the Mega-Pack (the box, in the middle of the quarters)
Place the cardboard Stenchmasters (the Mega-Pack)

title: Build-Your-Own S.E.S.
summary: Ages eight and up. Adult supervision strongly recommended.
description: Some parts not included. Find them, and build Garrick's bedroom television before he builds it himself.

objectives.text: Find the parts: forks (galley), horseshoe (hold stairs), coils (hold salvage crate), transformer (under the Mark II)
Build it (the barrel table, in the quarters)

title: Wire the Two Systems Together
summary: Ten feet, through the door? No. Up, round, and down.
description: Run Garrick's cable from the bedroom set to the Mark II, the way he insists: via cardboard Brogath, up through the deck, round a cannon, down the main hatch, and taped down so nobody trips.

objectives.text: Tie the cable off at cardboard Brogath (wherever you put him)
Clear a path for it on deck (the crates by the fore hatch)
Three turns round the starboard cannon
Tack it down across the galley floor (by the ladder)
Connect it to the Mark II

title: The Stenchmaster Channel
summary: Twenty-four hours of Ancient Stenchmaster history.
description: The bedroom set has a channel. Watch it.

objectives.text: Watch it (the bedroom set)

title: Stench-O-Vision
description: The bedroom set has a smell vent, and it's open. Shut it.

objectives.text: Turn off the Stench-O-Vision (the bedroom set's knobs)

title: Poor in Gold, Rich in Gas
description: The Stenchmaster Channel's Brogath special is on.

objectives.text: Watch it (the bedroom set)
Say it, at everything: the cardboard Stenchmasters, the sash bedding, the bedroom set, the locker, the Mega-Pack

title: Every Ancient Stenchmaster Is Here
description: Every Ancient Grand Stenchmaster in history is in this room, wearing your crew. Find out what they're planning.

objectives.text: Prevent Brogath from becoming bashful (talk to Pete)
Stop Rumpold meeting wind with wind (talk to Gristle)
Halt Sir Rumpus's legal validation (talk to Bob)
Console Lord Gustavio (talk to Jim)
Calm the Princess (talk to Squawks)
Assess the Prime (talk to Garrick)

title: DISARM THE ANCIENT STENCHMASTERS
description: Take away everything an Ancient Stenchmaster could use.

objectives.text: Remove the beans (the sack by the door)
Seal the Frog Grog (the cask)
Hide the Spicy Stench Sauce (the shelf)
Stop the raised fingers (talk to Bob)
Stabilise the sash fabric (a sash hammock)
Keep the Prime still (talk to Garrick)
Nobody rear-first to the weather (talk to Gristle)

title: Ancient Stenchmaster Apocalypse
description: Get the ship ready for the apocalypse. Real orders. Important caveats.

objectives.text: Trim the mainsail: DO NOT FART AT IT (the mainmast sheets)
Check the hull: KEEP FINGER DOWN (the starboard rail)
Secure the cannons: NO SASH FLUTTER (the port cannon)
Five degrees to port: REPORT STOMACH NOISES (the helm)
Clear the deck: ESPECIALLY BEANS (by the main hatch)

title: Two Brogaths
summary: This is Brogath. This is Pete.
description: Pete has brought cardboard Brogath up on deck to prove a point. Look at them both.

objectives.text: Look at them both (cardboard Brogath, and Pete)

title: Brogath in the Treasure Room
description: Something is growling in the treasure room. Get down there.

objectives.text: Get to the treasure room (below: the galley, then the hold)
Hear what Brogath... what Pete has to say (Pete)

title: The Brogath Command Crisis
description: Prove who's captain: hold her steady through the storm.

objectives.text: Keep Brogath away from the helm: hold her steady through three gusts (the helm)
